blocks.text: NEW YORK — One person was killed and several others injured Wednesday after a three-story building collapsed near a construction site in New York, city authorities said. Images from the scene showed firefighters sifting through a pile of rubble in front of what appeared to be a residential property with its walls torn down, exposing a bedroom and a clothing wardrobe. US media reported that some people were pulled from the rubble, including a child carried out on a stretcher.
